configuration.title: Project Timeline
configuration.idleTimeoutMinutes.descrip: Tolerance window (minutes) after the last editor interaction. Past this delay with no interaction, no active agent, and the window not staying in the foreground, the session is closed.
configuration.agentGraceMinutes.descript: An agent (Claude Code / Codex CLI) is considered active until N minutes after its last write to its session file.
configuration.suspendOnScreenLock.descri: Close the session when the window has been unfocused for a long time, even if an agent is running.
configuration.minSessionSeconds.descript: Sessions shorter than this duration are not recorded.
configuration.fileEditFlushSeconds.descr: Aggregation window for per-file edits before emitting a file_edit event.
